name: NinjaOne agent reset
installerCheck: Authenticode signature Valid with signer O=NinjaOne LLC (or O=NinjaRMM LLC). The generic MSI always serves the current agent, so there is no hash to pin; the agent updates itself after install.
packageArguments: Optional. {"Apply":"true"} (base64 eyJBcHBseSI6InRydWUifQ==) removes the old agent and installs the new one. Without Apply the run is read-only. The location token comes from the environment variable RELIAN_NINJA_TOKENID, never from the arguments.
